commentary.text: 90+16' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+16' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Kamil Grabara makes a smart save to deny him.
90+14' 3 - 3 Goal! Ragnar Ache gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 3:3.
90+12' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
90+12' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) whips in a cross from the corner, but Kamil Grabara is well positioned and punches the ball away.
90+11' Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. FC Koln have a corner.
90+9' 3 - 2 Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) scores a goal from the resulting free kick, sending it into the top right corner. What a strike that is, absolutely fantastic!
90+7' Bastian Dankert blows for a foul after Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Wolfsburg.
90+6' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
90+4' Vini Souza (Wolfsburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
90+1' 2 - 2 Goal! Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Said El Mala, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:2.
90' 14 additional min. will be played.
90' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
89' The referee signals a substitution. Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Andreas Skov Olsen.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Daghim is coming onto the pitch as Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
87' The attendance for today's match is 28917.
86' Kamil Grabara (Wolfsburg) gets a yellow card. The referee Bastian Dankert made the right call.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lovro Majer leaves the pitch and Jenson Seelt (Wolfsburg) comes on.
84' Today's referee Bastian Dankert rightly decides to book Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) for his harsh tackle.
83' A player from FC Koln commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
82' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for FC Koln.

82' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for FC Koln.
81' The corner kick from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
80' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Bastian Dankert saw the whole situation.
79' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
78' Substitution. Kristoffer Lund leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln).
77' The linesman raises his flag. Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) is adjudged offside.
75' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
74' Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots low towards goal, but Marvin Schwabe makes a magnificent save!
72' The foul by Joel Schmied (1. FC Koln) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Bastian Dankert.
71' Lukas Kwasniok is forced to make a change. Rav van den Berg is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln).
71' FC Koln failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
70' Mohamed Amoura is substituted due to injury. Paul Simonis gives a chance to Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg).
69' Ron-Robert Zieler (1. FC Koln) gets a yellow card, off the field.
69' The game is interrupted now, Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
68' Bastian Dankert shows a yellow card to Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
65' 2 - 1 Goal Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg)! Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) was put through by Joakim Maehle and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. 2:1.
64' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to make a change. Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) replaces Jan Thielmann.
64' Here comes a substitution. Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) is brought on as a substitute for Sebastian Sebulonsen.
61' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The FC Koln players look gutted.
57' The FC Koln players joy may have been justified, because referee Bastian Dankert is going use VAR to determine the legality of a challenge.
56' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
55' Bastian Dankert blows the whistle, Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) is penalised for a foul.
53' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
52' The resulting corner from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger. Wolfsburg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
51' Good movement by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
50' The match can continue after the interruption.
47' The game is interrupted.
46' Lukas Kwasniok makes a half-time substitution. Isak Johannesson comes on in place of Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Bastian Dankert has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) gets inside the box and tries to beat Kamil Grabara with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
44' Vini Souza (Wolfsburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Bastian Dankert interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

42' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Maximilian Arnold flights the free kick into the box, where Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) peels off his marker and heads straight into the top right corner from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:1.
42' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
40' A lofted cross from Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
39' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolfsburg comes to nothing.

38' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Marvin Schwabe easily deals with the threat. Wolfsburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
38' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
37' The resulting set piece from Wolfsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
36' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg). Good work from Wolfsburg as they win a corner.
35' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
33' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
30' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle. Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) commits a foul after dangerous play.
28' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
27' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Now Wolfsburg have a corner.

27' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
26' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) makes a strong challenge and Bastian Dankert blows for a foul.
24' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
24' The game is interrupted.
21' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
19' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
17' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
15' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
12' A pass by Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
10' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
8' Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
5' Kamil Grabara pulls off a great save to deny Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
3' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
1' The first half has just begun.
FC Koln will kick-off.
Bastian Dankert was nominated as the referee for this game.
